## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project formatting: `cargo fmt --check`
- [ ] Rust linter passes: `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- [ ] All tests pass: `cargo test`

- [ ] Updated `PROGRESS.md` if this completes an active phase task
- [ ] Recorded ADR in `docs/decisions/` if an architectural change was introduced
